The '''Merchant Council Building''' or '''Council House''' was located in [[Isttu Village]] aboard the [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']], an [[Ithorian Herdship]]. It was the headquarters of the local [[merchantate]].
